data.long_meaning: The name Kreeshansh is derived from the Sanskrit language, originating from the name of Lord Krishna. This name signifies the grace and blessings of Lord Krishna, the god of wealth and prosperity. The name Kreeshansh carries the meaning “God of wealth Krishna's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kreeshansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wealth krishna's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
